arguments.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE professional app-icon concept comparison board for ClipCat, a quiet desktop cat companion and PRIVATE LOCAL clipboard manager. This is an exploratory presentation, not a shipping icon asset. Wide landscape canvas, warm off-white gallery background, exactly three equally spaced columns, each containing one large impeccably crafted app icon and a simple typographic label A, B, C underneath. No other words. No device mockups, no desktop screenshots, no extra badges.
The current rejected direction was a generic front-facing cartoon cat drawn inside a flat thick blue clipboard outline. Avoid that entire construction, flat emoji faces, thick blue contours, childish stock clipart, and obvious standard clipboard UI shapes. Aim for memorable independent Mac/Windows app branding with refined silhouettes and carefully controlled dimensionality.
A: A premium tactile 2.5D illustrated bicolor Ragdoll cat, cream fur and seal-brown ears/mask/tail, bright gentle blue eyes, curled in a compact C-shaped loaf protectively hugging ONE small folded ivory paper slip between its white front paws. The cat's expressive head is slightly turned in three-quarter view, not a flat frontal face. Minimal sculpted fur shapes, soft satin/clay texture with subtle illustrator warmth, no individual hair noise. Ivory rounded-square app-icon tile with a very restrained pale-blue interior atmosphere, realistic soft contact shadow. Cat occupies most of tile. This feels like the actual friendly desktop pet and communicates caring for a copied note.
B: A sophisticated minimal papercraft icon: ONE folded ivory sheet sculpted into an unmistakable sitting cat silhouette, with two pointed ears, a curved folded tail and a small deep-teal inner fold. Restrained geometric editorial design, no face or tiny eyes, no text on paper. Muted deep petrol-blue rounded-square icon tile. A few beautiful folds and gentle relief shadow, strong negative space and bold silhouette at small size. Not a clipboard, not a cat face sticker.
C: A warm collectible stationery icon: a relaxed cream cat with dark warm ears peeks diagonally out of a rounded terracotta document pocket containing two ivory note cards. One paw rests naturally over the pocket edge, one soft curled tail appears at the side. Cream ceramic rounded-square icon tile, beautifully crafted soft 3D with tactile matte paper and ceramic materials, warm terracotta and muted desaturated blue accent. Cat expression calm and slightly mischievous. Avoid office folder yellow, busy stacks, blue clipboard outlines and fish.
All three must feel plausibly shipping-quality but clearly DIFFERENT visual directions: A character/companionship, B distilled paper symbol, C organized stationery companion. Consistent visual scale, generous spacing, icon fills 75-85% of its column, careful lighting, no harsh gloss, no neon, no chrome, no letters in icon artwork. Only A B C labels outside icons.

purpose: Exploratory comparison board after user rejected the first code-generated icon; not selected or applied
